dimensions.assessment: Applies to federal, state, and local agencies, special districts, public or nonprofit agencies, and other public or private entities participating in San Francisco Bay restoration projects.
dimensions.evidence: interagency agreements, contracts, or other funding mechanisms to Federal, State, and local agencies, special districts, public or nonprofit agencies, and other public or private entities

dimensions.assessment: Affects project funding limits (not to exceed 75 percent of total cost) and places restrictions on foreign entities of concern receiving funds.
dimensions.evidence: Amounts provided for a project, activity, or study under this section shall not exceed an amount that is equal to 75 percent of the total cost

dimensions.assessment: Modifies cost-share requirements (at least 25 percent from non-federal sources) without explicitly stating total national spending figures.
dimensions.evidence: Not less than 25 percent of the cost of any project, activity, or study carried out using amounts provided to a non-Federal entity under this section shall be provided from non-Federal sources

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutory provisions concerning program implementation, funding mechanisms, and eligibility criteria under the Federal Water Pollution Control Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 125 of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1276a) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes affecting the ongoing administration and execution of the San Francisco Bay restoration program.

missing_information: Total dollar amounts authorized or appropriated for the restoration program.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act regarding the San Francisco Bay restoration program by expanding funding mechanisms and setting non-federal cost-share and foreign-entity restrictions, leading to moderate procedural and structural changes for participating agencies.
